# Time2Read

> Personalized, interactive reading adventures for children aged 3–15, with AI-generated illustrations, phonetic learning, and text-to-speech narration.

Time2Read creates never-ending, age-appropriate stories tailored to each child's reading level (PreK–10th grade). Free guests get 20-minute sessions with 6-page stories; Premium subscribers get unlimited live story generation, a saved story library, voice narration, and parent analytics.

- [Home](/): Create a personalized reading adventure.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Free, Premium, and Enterprise plans.
